name: ButtonGroup
description: An attached single-select button group (segmented control) whose active indicator springs between options, measured from the real button widths. Supports pill, solid and underline indicators and full arrow-key navigation.
a11yNotes: Follows the WAI-ARIA radio group pattern: role="radiogroup" labelled by `label`, each option is role="radio" with aria-checked. Roving tabindex makes the group a single Tab stop; Arrow keys move focus and select (wrapping), Home/End jump to the first/last option. The sliding indicator is aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the indicator jumps without a transition.

propsApi.name: options
propsApi.description: Option labels; each label is also its value.

propsApi.name: onValueChange
propsApi.description: Called with the newly selected option.

propsApi.name: indicator
propsApi.description: Raised neutral pill, accent-filled pill, or accent underline.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Accent color for the solid and underline indicators.

propsApi.name: fullWidth
propsApi.description: Fill the container and split options evenly.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
